title: Dictation that never fails in the browser

chat.text: Your Part 7 list, worked in order: what Reconnect really reconnects, catching errors and profiling the freezes, a compact Debug tab (green/red lights over a log), each sentence's life in that log, and the misordered bubbles fixed at the data. Already done: the leftover Whisper servers that ate your RAM came from one test, and that test now cleans up after itself (178c1037d).

message.text: Fixed: the extra Whisper servers that used up your RAM. One test was being killed before it could clean up; it now sweeps up after itself, and only Servex's own Whisper is running. In progress: one builder doing Reconnect, refresh-then-dictate, catching every error and the compact Debug tab, merged one step at a time. Two agents are measuring the slow chat load and the freezes, and finding where the bubble order goes wrong.

Found why "now?" appeared above "Can you hear me?": the data was in order, but the chat sorted bubbles by two different clocks (the phone's and the PC's). A three-line fix is being finished now, with a test that replays the moment; I'll merge it next.
